question: Which workshops belong to a conference, and what are their submission deadlines?
server_diagnostics_note: Server token counters and debug files are shared across requests; do not use them for per-run measurements during concurrent requests.

response.question: Which workshops belong to a conference, and what are their submission deadlines?
response.query:
PREFIX edas: <http://edas#>
PREFIX ekaw: <http://ekaw#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?workshop ?submissionDeadline WHERE { { SERVICE <http://192.168.100.45:3030/edas/sparql> { ?workshop a edas:Workshop . ?workshop edas:hasCall ?call . ?call edas:hasSubmissionDeadline ?submissionDeadline . } SERVICE <http://192.168.100.45:3030/ekaw/sparql> { ?workshopEkaw owl:sameAs ?workshop . ?workshopEkaw a ekaw:Workshop . ?workshopEkaw ekaw:partOfEvent ?conference . ?conference a ekaw:Conference . } } UNION { SERVICE <http://192.168.100.45:3030/ekaw/sparql> { ?workshop a ekaw:Workshop . ?workshop ekaw:partOfEvent ?conference2 . ?conference2 a ekaw:Conference . } SERVICE <http://192.168.100.45:3030/edas/sparql> { ?workshopEdas owl:sameAs ?workshop . ?workshopEdas a edas:Workshop . ?workshopEdas edas:hasCall ?call2 . ?call2 edas:hasSubmissionDeadline ?submissionDeadline . } } }
